Our review confirms the injury was discovered on 2024-12-15, within the two-year statute of limitations from the date of injury (2023-06-15), and the discovery rule in Illinois tolls the limitation period until the injury is reasonably discoverable. The case remains active with key deadlines approaching: response to interrogatories due 2025-01-10, deposition of key witness scheduled for 2025-01-25, and mediation set for 2025-02-14. All procedural postures remain favorable. Reference: DOC-EXT-3304.
